articles.title: Snake Skin Left on Bed, Girl Disappears: Love Affair Behind ‘Filmy Drama’ in Auraiya
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre incident came to light in Auraiya district, Uttar Pradesh, where a 25-year-old woman staged a dramatic disappearance by leaving a five-foot snake’s skin on her bed, triggering panic and superstition in her village.

body.html:
A bizarre incident came to light in Auraiya district, Uttar Pradesh, where a 25-year-old woman staged a dramatic disappearance by leaving a five-foot snake’s skin on her bed, triggering panic and superstition in her village. The incident occurred in Singanpur village under the Phaphund police station area.

The woman, identified as Reena, daughter of Rakesh Valmiki, went missing around 3 am on Sunday. Before leaving home, she placed a snake’s skin along with a ring, necklace and bangle on her bed. When family members went to wake her on Monday morning, they found the snake skin and began claiming that Reena had “turned into a serpent”, drawing large crowds to the house.

Villagers alerted the police about her sudden disappearance. On reaching the spot and conducting an investigation, police revealed that the entire episode was a planned drama. According to police, Reena was having a love affair with a young man from the same village, while her family was arranging her marriage elsewhere. To escape the pressure, she allegedly staged the incident and fled.

Locals told police that Reena had been searching in nearby fields for the past two days, possibly looking for a snake skin. Villagers also claimed that her family was aware of the relationship and had even assaulted her earlier, but she refused to end the affair.

Reena had studied up to Class 8 and is the youngest among five daughters and two sons, with four sisters already married.

Phaphund SHO Ajay Kumar said, “This appears to be a completely fabricated incident. The girl’s mobile phone has been put on surveillance and search efforts are underway. She will be recovered soon.” Police said the family is currently not sharing detailed information.

articles.title: BJP Leader Accused of Assaulting Woman in MP’s Sidhi, Viral Video Triggers Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of alleged brutality against a woman has surfaced from Sidhi district in Madhya Pradesh, after a video purportedly showing a BJP leader assaulting a female vegetable vendor in public went viral on social media.

body.html:
A shocking case of alleged brutality against a woman has surfaced from Sidhi district in Madhya Pradesh, after a video purportedly showing a BJP leader assaulting a female vegetable vendor in public went viral on social media. The incident reportedly occurred on February 7, 2026, in Bahri village under the Sihawal Assembly constituency, barely 100 metres from the Bahri police station.

In the viral footage, Santosh Pathak, identified as a BJP leader, is seen beating the woman with a stick, pulling her by the hair, throwing her to the ground, and repeatedly kicking and punching her. Several bystanders were present at the spot, but none intervened. The victim has been identified as Hema Singh, a resident of Bhanwar village.

According to the complaint, the assault stemmed from a long-standing dispute over a roadside vegetable stall (gumti) near the bus stand, on land claimed to be government property. The woman alleged that Pathak had earlier vandalised her stall, forced her to vacate the spot, and later removed her handcart to set up his own business. When she returned to sell vegetables, she was allegedly abused and assaulted.

Bahri police station has registered a case against Santosh Pathak under IPC Sections 323 (voluntarily causing hurt), 294 (obscene acts), and 506 (criminal intimidation). However, no arrest has been made so far, prompting allegations of police inaction. Local residents claim the accused enjoys political patronage, being close to a sitting BJP MLA.

The incident has sparked a political storm. Congress leader Jitu Patwari shared the video on social media and questioned the law and order situation under the BJP government, demanding immediate arrest. Former minister Kamleshwar Patel also condemned the incident, alleging administrative failure and accusing the police of shielding the accused.

Despite the FIR, the accused has reportedly defended himself through Facebook Live, while the victim continues to approach senior officials seeking justice. Police officials say the investigation is ongoing, and further action will be taken based on the probe findings.

articles.title: Car Trainer Kidnapped at Gunpoint in Broad Daylight, Rescued After 3 Hours in Meerut | CCTV Surfaces
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A car trainer was allegedly kidnapped at gunpoint in Meerut’s Dhirkheda area under Kharkhoda police station limits on Sunday. The abduction was carried out by criminals who arrived in a car, and the entire incident was captured on CCTV.

body.html:
A car trainer was allegedly kidnapped at gunpoint in Meerut’s Dhirkheda area under Kharkhoda police station limits on Sunday. The abduction was carried out by criminals who arrived in a car, and the entire incident was captured on CCTV.

After receiving information, police launched an immediate operation and set up barricades across the area. Under pressure from the police blockade, the accused abandoned the victim and fled. The kidnapped trainer was rescued safely within three hours.

Meerut Police said that both parties were previously acquainted. Based on the victim’s complaint, a case has been registered at Kharkhoda police station under relevant sections of law. Police teams are currently searching for the accused, and further legal action is underway.

articles.title: Late for Exam, Student Slaps Teacher Inside School | CCTV Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was reported at S J Dave High School in Shehra town, where an 18-year-old student allegedly assaulted a teacher after being questioned for arriving late to a Plus Two examination on January 24.

body.html:
A shocking incident was reported at S J Dave High School in Shehra town, where an 18-year-old student allegedly assaulted a teacher after being questioned for arriving late to a Plus Two examination on January 24.

According to police, the accused, Mohammed Khan Ansari, got into an argument with the teacher inside the exam hall and allegedly slapped and pushed him. The incident was captured on CCTV, which later surfaced on social media. After the assault, the student fled the classroom.

Later the same day, the student’s father visited the school and apologised. However, on January 27, the accused allegedly returned to the school along with his father and around 10 others, and threatened the teacher, who lives alone.

Police registered a case on February 3 and arrested the student. He was taken to the school to recreate the incident as part of the investigation. The court has since granted him bail, while the probe continues.

articles.title: PUBG Turns Fatal: 22-Year-Old Gamer Collapses, Dies After BP Shoots Past 300
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 22-year-old man died after collapsing while playing the online game PUBG in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. The deceased, Mohammad Kaif, fainted suddenly while gaming on his mobile phone and was rushed to hospital, where doctors found his blood pressure had crossed 300, leading to a brain...

body.html:
A 22-year-old man died after collapsing while playing the online game PUBG in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. The deceased, Mohammad Kaif, fainted suddenly while gaming on his mobile phone and was rushed to hospital, where doctors found his blood pressure had crossed 300, leading to a brain haemorrhage.

The incident occurred on Friday at an office in Khairnagar, where Kaif, son of a real estate businessman, was playing PUBG with earphones on. He lost consciousness and was first taken to a nearby nursing home before being referred to Delhi due to his critical condition.

Kaif was admitted to Safdarjung Hospital, where doctors confirmed that a brain artery had burst due to extremely high blood pressure. Despite two days of treatment, he died on Sunday.

Family members said Kaif spent long hours on his mobile phone playing online games. His parents, devastated by the loss of their only son, have appealed for greater awareness about the health risks linked to excessive mobile gaming.

articles.title: Toddler’s Death Sparks Violence: Mob Pelts Stones at Hathras Police Station, SHO Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension gripped Mursan town in Hathras district on Sunday evening after an angry mob pelted stones at the local police station following the death of a two-and-a-half-year-old child in a road accident.

body.html:
Tension gripped Mursan town in Hathras district on Sunday evening after an angry mob pelted stones at the local police station following the death of a two-and-a-half-year-old child in a road accident. The SHO and a constable were injured, and property inside the police station was damaged.

The incident began around 3.30 pm when a speeding Ertiga car hit the child, identified as Yash, while he was playing outside his house in Madhaiya locality. He was rushed to hospital and later referred to Aligarh, but succumbed to his injuries on the way.

After the child’s death, family members and locals gathered at the Mursan police station, demanding that the accused be handed over to them. Protesters blocked the Mathura–Bareilly road outside the thana, bringing traffic to a halt.

Despite police arresting the driver and co-worker and seizing the vehicle, the situation worsened. A group of miscreants began pelting stones at the police station from nearby railway tracks, injuring police personnel and damaging vehicles and property.

Additional police forces were rushed to the spot, and the crowd was dispersed using force. Three persons have been arrested so far. SP Hathras Chiranjeev Nath Sinha said those involved in the violence are being identified and strict action will be taken. The situation is now under control.

articles.title: “I Am Thakur, Don’t Mess With Me”: HDFC Bank Staffer’s Caste Remark Sparks Outrage in Kanpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversy has erupted at an HDFC Bank branch in Panki, Kanpur, after a video showing a female employee arguing aggressively with a customer went viral on social media.

body.html:
A controversy has erupted at an HDFC Bank branch in Panki, Kanpur, after a video showing a female employee arguing aggressively with a customer went viral on social media.

The employee, identified as Aastha Singh, is seen using abusive language during a heated exchange that reportedly began after a customer raised a complaint. In the video, she is heard saying, “I am a Thakur, don’t do bakch@di with me,” a remark that has triggered widespread backlash online.

Other bank staff can be seen trying to calm the situation, but the argument continues. The caste-related comment has drawn sharp criticism, with many users calling it unprofessional and demanding strict action from HDFC Bank.

Some social media users, however, have claimed that the customer behaved rudely first, leading to the confrontation. As of now, HDFC Bank has not issued an official statement on the incident.

articles.title: Drunk Brawl on Bengaluru Road: Two Women Assault Cab Driver After Bike Crash, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two women, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, created a late-night ruckus in Bengaluru after their bike rammed into a cab and they allegedly assaulted the driver.

body.html:
Two women, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, created a late-night ruckus in Bengaluru after their bike rammed into a cab and they allegedly assaulted the driver. The incident, which occurred near Hulimavu on Bannerghatta Road, was captured on camera and has gone viral on social media.

According to reports, the women were returning after visiting friends when they hit the cab from behind. When the cab driver, identified as Ahmed, questioned them, an argument broke out. The women allegedly abused him and attacked him with a helmet. Locals who tried to intervene were also reportedly assaulted, with some witnesses claiming the women used a chain during the attack.

Videos show the women shouting abuses, making obscene gestures, and kicking people who attempted to restrain them. Even after being taken into a police vehicle, one of them continued to yell and behave aggressively. The video could not be independently verified.

Police reached the spot after receiving complaints and registered a case against the two women, identified as Lisa and Matthew. Both have been taken into custody, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: UP Shock: Man Marries Three Women in 6 Years, Takes Dowry, Throws Them Out—Now Planning 4th Wedding
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of fraud and dowry harassment has surfaced in Uttar Pradesh’s Jhansi district, where a man allegedly married three women over six years, took dowry from each, and later abandoned them.

body.html:
A shocking case of fraud and dowry harassment has surfaced in Uttar Pradesh’s Jhansi district, where a man allegedly married three women over six years, took dowry from each, and later abandoned them.

The matter came to light on Friday when the three women jointly approached the Jhansi SSP office to file a complaint against their husband, Sunil Kumar, a resident of Jamura Mahi village in Lalitpur district.

According to police, Sunil married the women in 2019, 2021 and 2023, allegedly keeping each wife unaware of the others. The women accused him of demanding dowry, assaulting them and forcing them out of his house after a few months of marriage. One wife was allegedly thrown out while pregnant.

The complainants alleged that Sunil’s motive was to extort cash and jewellery as dowry. Each family reportedly spent around ₹8 lakh on the marriages. After fulfilling initial demands, the women said Sunil began asking for additional dowry and later sought divorce.

One of the wives had earlier filed a dowry harassment case against him at Jakhaura police station in Lalitpur. Police said Sunil was also planning a fourth marriage.

Babina SHO JP Pal confirmed that a fraud case is being registered based on the complaints and action will be taken against the accused. Further investigation is underway.

#UttarPradesh #Jhansi #DowryHarassment #TripleMarriage #MarriageFraud #UPCrime #WomenSpeakUp #BreakingNews
